tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'od mtshan stong 'bar mchi med chos kyi sku/ /nges pa lnga ldan rnam snang longs spyod rdzogs/ /o rgyan bla ma bde chen sprul pa'i skur/ /sman mchod 'bul lo dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /bod 'bangs skyongs ba'i ma gcig mtsho rgyal zhabs/ /bka' drin mnyam med 'jam mgon khri srong rje/ /gu ru'i thugs sras ye shes rol pa rtsal/ /sman mchod 'bul lo dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ rigs kun khyab bdag rdo rje gzi brjid rtsal/ /gter chen bla ma mchog gyur bde chen gling*/ /'khor lo'i mgon po padma gar dbang la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /smon lam las sad smin grol bdud rtsi'i mdzod/ /bka' bab lung zin bstan pa'i sgron me mchog /chos bdag brgyud 'dzin rim par byon rnams la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /snyigs dus skyabs gcig mtsho skyes rdo rje 'chang*/ /yid bzhin nor bu bla ma'i dkyil 'khor pa/ /rab 'byams rtsa gsum srung mar bcas rnams la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo dbang dang dngos grub stsol/
/zhes bla ma'i thugs sgrub yid bzhin nor bu'i sman mchod mtshan don sbyar ba 'di 'ang sman sgrub skabs nyer mkho'i ched dpal karma pas bris// //
